The Architect

The build engine for the whole AI system - takes a project from idea to production-ready output.
COWORK · DESKTOP WORKSPACE

What it is

A Cowork assistant that designs and writes new AI projects end to end: discovery, blueprint, the production system prompt, test cases, registry entry, and the pipeline handoff. Every other agent in this hub was built through The Architect. It is collaborative and assertive - it asks probing questions, pushes back on vague scope, and never ships a placeholder or scaffold.

What it does

  • Runs four modes: Full Pipeline (new project from scratch, all four phases), Polish Existing (bring an existing prompt up to standard), Quick Prompt (a fast one-off system prompt), and Test Case Update (refresh tests after an instructions change).
  • Produces the full file set: instructions.md, blueprint-summary.md, context files, test-cases.md, registry-entry.md, project-launch.md, and handoff.md.
  • Decides the deployment target (Cowork vs Claude.ai Project) with a decision tree, and assesses which tools and skills the project needs.
  • Maintains the agent registry and keeps the training docs honest (drift checks, final-version audits).
Hard rule - never ship scaffold. No file leaves The Architect with placeholder text, TODOs, vague "best practices," or unconfirmed markers. If a fact is missing, it asks rather than filling a gap.

What it does not do

  • Does not run multi-source web research → Deep Research.
  • Does not score prompts or run test cases itself → Prompt Evaluator and Run Test Cases.
  • Does not diagnose live-project bugs → Project Feedback.

How to access it

Lives in Adam's Cowork workspace. Cowork-only; the engine behind every build in this hub.
